mapper.select: SELECT id, group_id, label, display_order, created_at, updated_at FROM report_item_subtitles WHERE group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY display_order ASC

SELECT rist.id, rist.group_id, rist.label, rist.display_order, rist.created_at, rist.updated_at FROM report_item_subtitles rist JOIN report_item_groups rig ON rig.id = rist.group_id WHERE rig.student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report_item_subtitles (id, group_id, label, display_order) VALUES (#{id}, #{groupId}, #{label}, #{displayOrder})
